purpose: Identify Airbnb hotel production and economic contribution in a large, auditable panel; not a request for guest personal information.
status: Requested schema; no underlying hotel booking panel has been obtained.

confirmed_market_scope.missing_market_policy: Retain all 13 markets and report missing data explicitly; a zero-coverage export is not zero Airbnb bookings.
confirmed_market_scope.geography_policy: Preserve provider destination boundaries and reconcile to the listing-panel market before ratios or aggregation.

preferred_coverage.period: 2024-01-01 through latest available 2026 stay month, with forward bookings distinguished
preferred_coverage.unit: One unique reservation with room counts and lifecycle records, or a hotel-month-channel aggregate with known denominator
preferred_coverage.selection: All covered independent/boutique hotels, including zero-Airbnb-production hotels and exits; geographic and affiliation filters explicit
preferred_coverage.scale: All eligible covered properties; effective sample size determined by unique hotels/operators and observed variance, not raw row count

acceptance_checks: HotelTonight and Airbnb storefront bookings must be separable or explicitly unresolved.
Hotel owner room revenue, guest spend, GBV and Airbnb net revenue are separate metrics.
No room-night count is inferred from card transactions without stay dates and room quantities.
Deduplicate confirmations, amendments, receipts and refunds at reservation level.
A zero-night record with inconsistent stay dates must be flagged, not silently accepted or imputed.
Retain genuine zero production and distinguish it from missing source coverage.
A receipt-panel user is not a hotel; report both unique consumers and unique hotels.
Sum nights and prices only after reconciling currency, room versus guest nights and cancellation treatment.
Public registry size is not the production-panel denominator.
Only use population expansion weights when their construction and covered population are known.
